title: On Seeking advice from the oldest man
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：seek　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 seek 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the guide ① sought advice from the oldest man with great care, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② seeks advice from the oldest man on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ seek advice from the oldest man at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ sought advice from the oldest man before — a line in the guidebook for July 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Seeking advice from the oldest man with great care, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ seek shelter along the whole shore on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Seek shelter along the whole shore at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ seeks shelter along the whole shore with great care every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ sought advice from the oldest man again when nobody else would.

⑩ To seek advice from the oldest man, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody seeks advice from the oldest man on the same day again and somebody must seek advice from the oldest man with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 请教（一般过去式 sought advice from the oldest man：1990 年向导头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 请教（一般现在 seeks advice from the oldest man：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 请教（不定式 to seek advice from the oldest man：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 请教（过去完成时 had sought advice from the oldest man：1984 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 请教（动名词 seeking advice from the oldest man 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 寻找（seek shelter along the whole shore：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去寻找沿着整个海岸寻找避风处）
G. v. 寻找（seek shelter along the whole shore：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 请教（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 seeks shelter along the whole shore，而母亲又一次 sought advice from the oldest man）

answers.why: seek 意为“请教”，1990 年向导小心翼翼地请教去向最年长的那位请教，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 sought。
seek 意为“请教”，自那以后向导当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 seeks。
seek 意为“请教”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯请教去向最年长的那位请教”，此处为不定式 to seek advice from the oldest man。
seek 意为“请教”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1997 年之前就有人请教过，故用过去完成时 had sought。
seek 意为“请教”，向导说“请教去向最年长的那位请教这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 seeking advice from the oldest man 作主语。
seek 意为“寻找”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去寻找沿着整个海岸寻找避风处”，should ever 之后用原形 seek shelter along the whole shore。
seek 意为“寻找”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻寻找沿着整个海岸寻找避风处（seek shelter along the whole shore at once），以后再也不要提起。
seek 意为“请教”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例寻找沿着整个海岸寻找避风处，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 seeks。
seek 意为“请教”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地请教去向最年长的那位请教，用一般过去式 sought 叙述。
seek 意为“请教”，结尾那句是母亲 2002 年的话：要请教去向最年长的那位请教，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1990 the guide sought advice from the oldest man with great care, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide seeks advice from the oldest man on the same day whenever the valley asks.
Seeking advice from the oldest man with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever seek shelter along the whole shore on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
